scope: Real Gemini Live voice-control rehearsal with synthesized learner audio and simulated video playback. No physical-device test.
input: Samantha synthesized microphone PCM,16kHz mono,paced20ms packets with continuous silence;automatic VAD

milestones.name: overview complete placement waits for Ready

spokenTranscriptReview.method: Joined actual assistant transcription fragments into utterances, then reviewed complete text and counted distinctive authored opening phrases.
spokenTranscriptReview.expectedRepetition: The practice default occurred twice: initial explicit camera skip and a second explicit skip after the hand-placement replay.

interruptedDefaults.cause: Harness sent Ready before the new generation completed its authored narration.
Harness sent explicit camera skip before the new generation completed its authored narration.

spokenTranscriptReview.recapTranscript: The demonstration was watched. Placement not verified. You confirmed finishing this practice round. Say “next” for the measurement limits.
spokenTranscriptReview.limitsTranscript: I haven’t measured compression depth, force or cadence. This practice does not certify competence. You can practise again, review placement or end the session.

limitations: No phone, glasses, camera frames, wearer-readable display, speaker playback or speaker-loop echo were exercised.
The phone device configuration does not test native HUD-receipt gating.
Device capabilities and playing/ended events were simulated. Playback ended after 500 ms; actual 55-second and 5-second media durations were not exercised.
Video cue drain used simulated pendingMs=0/writtenSamples reports, fenced by current generation and speechEpoch and sent only after narration.generatedAt.

Post-video Ready and explicit skip interrupted the two authored starting-position prompts due to an early harness settle condition. Their full audible delivery was not verified. Future harness waits now require a bound active generation and current-page narration generation.
No visual placement judgment was exercised; both skips remained learner-confirmed and the recap explicitly said placement was not verified.
One successful run establishes this voice-control path, not repeated reliability or physical end-to-end readiness.
